Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a single 16:9 raster background for the browser platformer Adventures of Pierre, preferably 1280x720 or a larger exact 16:9 PNG.
Input image 1 is STYLE AND COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Generate a NEW EGYPTIAN DESERT / DUNES background in exactly this deliberately simple school-project MS Paint style. Match the original's broad flat fills, a simple two-color vertical sky gradient, thick uneven hand-drawn outlines, rounded rolling hills, sparse composition, and slightly wobbly juvenile drawing. Do not upgrade it into polished fantasy concept art.
Scene: a bright Egyptian desert. Replace the green hills with two layers of softly rolling ochre and pale-gold dunes, outlined in muted burnt sienna. Two very simple small pyramids sit FAR AWAY along the horizon, with triangular faces in only two flat colors, nothing ornate. A SINGLE oversized round yellow sun is partially cropped by the upper-left corner with blunt, uneven hand-drawn rays, echoing the reference. Sky is clear light turquoise fading to pale warm lavender near the horizon.
Composition: wide flat side-view backdrop, no camera perspective ground plane. Horizon stays around 52% of image height. Keep the lower 40% an uninterrupted solid sandy fill with no objects or shading, and the central area very quiet so Pierre, actual platforms, checkpoints and enemies remain readable. Do not draw gameplay terrain, platforms, floors, ledges, characters, animals, props, UI, lettering or borders.
Preserve the charming minimalism of the reference. No grain, textures, realistic light, 3D rendering, detailed brushwork, dramatic shadows, repeated suns, decorative clouds, or collage/contact sheet. One finished standalone background, fully opaque.

A single pale ochre sun is partially cropped in the upper-left corner, echoing the original. Keep it daytime/twilight, NOT a dark interior.
Composition: level side view with horizon around 52% down; most landmarks stay between 35% and 55% image height. Lower 40% is an uninterrupted flat sandy clay fill, empty and quiet behind gameplay. No detailed foreground, no floor perspective, no ground textures. The game draws its own platforms and objects over this.
No characters, animals, gameplay platforms, ledges, obstacles, UI, logos, text, borders, collage, realistic textures, photographic effects or 3D. No extra suns. Match the rough, modest charm of the school-project reference rather than making it professionally illustrated. One finished landscape only.
